Operator guide

Finding a record

The equipment register lists every record. Each row has its own View, Edit and Remove controls, labelled with the record's tag. The locations page narrows the list to one place.

Editing a record

Open Edit for the row, change the fields you need, and give a reason for the change. The reason is mandatory: a save without one is refused. After a save the record page shows which fields were written and the values the register now holds for them.

Custody

The custodian recorded at registration stays on the record. Later reassignments are kept in a separate custody ledger, and the register always shows the most recent custodian.

Registering and removing

Use Register equipment to add a record; it is given the next free tag. Removing a record asks for confirmation first and cannot be undone. Tags are never reused.

Audit

Everything done in a session is listed in the change log. Display options are under Preferences.
